name: Братья-могильщики
alt: Братья-могильщики гордятся игрушечным планером, в который ни один не помещается.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Two distinct whole characters, each exactly two arms, cheerful undead inventors.
